t.68891-38-3.agn: It has no EU harmonised classification; in the registrants' joint notification it is classified as skin irritation and serious eye damage (for the pure substance).
t.68891-38-3.reg.clp: No EU harmonised classification. Registrants' joint notification (50.7% of notifications): Skin Irrit. 2, Eye Dam. 1.
t.68891-38-3.summary: An anionic surfactant; common in detergents and shampoos.
t.68891-38-3.what: Dissolves dirt and grease and produces plenty of foam.
